# Security Policy

## Reporting a vulnerability

Report suspected vulnerabilities privately through GitHub's private
vulnerability reporting for this repository. Do not open a public issue or
include credentials, tokens, personal data, or production data in a report.

Include the affected component, a concise reproduction, impact, and any safe
mitigation. Maintainers will coordinate remediation and disclosure.

## Scope

This policy covers the UTTT-GO mobile repository and its CI/CD configuration.
Backend and infrastructure vulnerabilities must be reported to their
respective maintainers.
